author: PARTHA BEHERA
description: A video of a student assault at Swami Atmanand School has gone viral online. The victim's family alleged school authorities took no action after the incident. The accused student's mother reportedly created a scene at the police station. Police registered bailable offences against both students involved in the argument. The victim obtained a transfer certificate fearing further harassment.
title: ‘Hum don hain’: Raipur student assaulted at school, video posted online

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Dalal Street wrapped up last week on a high note, showcasing impressive gains among leading firms. State Bank of India saw a remarkable surge in its market value, joining industry giants Reliance Industries and TCS, which also experienced robust growth. Conversely, several other major companies faced decreases in their market valuations. Despite some volatility, overall market indices noted steady gains as the week closed.
title: Market recap: Four of top 10 firms add Rs 1.43 lakh crore; SBI bags biggest gains

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Rahul Gandhi criticized Prime Minister Modi and home minister Shah for their response to student protests.  He stated that students are the nation's light and he stands with them.  Gandhi highlighted student struggles with education and lack of employment opportunities.  He warned youth against social media distractions as jobs are shrinking.  The Congress leader alleged RSS ideology appointments affected institutional systems.
title: 'Answer for crime': Rahul attacks PM, Shah over police brutality against students

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Jana Nayagan continues its theatrical run, showing a gradual slowdown in its third weekend.  The film has garnered significant box office collections across India and overseas markets.  Its total India net collection has reached Rs 188.50 crore and worldwide gross Rs 312.86 crore.  The political action drama features Thalapathy Vijay in a lead role.  The movie's performance reflects its strong audience reception since its release.
title: Jana Nayagan box office day 18: Vijay’s film eyes Rs 320 crore worldwide

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: The competition between the US and China in the realm of artificial intelligence has shifted focus towards harnessing model capabilities rather than merely their creation. AI model distillation enables smaller systems to mimic larger counterparts, which has sparked concerns over security. There are reports that Chinese military researchers are utilizing outputs from US AI models for defense purposes.
title: What is AI model distillation and why is it becoming a US-China flashpoint?

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In a striking act of cultural exploration, a Ukrainian model sought out a father figure in Japan, creating a viral sensation. This unique experience opened her heart, allowing her to experience the essence of daughterly love for the first time. The emotional goodbye with her rental dad proved to be more challenging than she had imagined, highlighting Japan's innovative perspective on fostering human connections in an increasingly detached world.
title: Woman tries Japan’s ‘rent-a-dad’ service and finds goodbye unexpectedly hard

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Sharks are being used as mobile ocean sensors by University of Delaware researchers in a new study that could help improve hurricane forecasts. Electronic tags attached to sharks collect water temperature, salinity and depth data as the animals move through the Atlantic. Scientists hope the information will improve understanding of ocean conditions that influence hurricane intensity.
title: US scientists tag sharks to help forecast hurricane intensification

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: India's government is considering raising the foreign investment approval threshold significantly. This move aims to attract larger overseas investments and simplify the process. The current Rs 5,000 crore limit has been in place since 2015. Changes to downstream investment rules are also being explored to facilitate capital. These efforts are part of a broader strategy to boost economic growth.
title: Centre weighs 200% increase in foreign investment approval threshold

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: New York City has announced an extension for the pied-à-terre tax exemption deadline to September eighteenth, responding to resident concerns about the lack of clear notifications and the complexities of the exemption process. To enhance communication citywide, particularly across boroughs, outreach initiatives are being intensified. The pied-à-terre tax impacts secondary residences valued at over five million dollars, a strategy designed to bolster the city's budget amid a financial shortfall.
title: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani extends tax deadline after residents call emails 'unclear'

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Ajinkya Rahane advocates for a firm commitment to Rohit Sharma's position ahead of the 2027 World Cup. He suggests that selectors should avoid evaluating the seasoned opener based on individual series, as this ambiguity can negatively affect a player's mental state and performance. Rahane highlights Rohit's invaluable experience as vital for success in the major upcoming tournament and urges for clearer guidance to aid his preparation.
title: 'Can’t go series by series': Rahane demands clarity over Rohit Sharma's WC spot

author: TOI NEWS DESK
title: ‘Stones, shoes thrown at my car’: Mamata faces protest at TMC worker’s home

author: ANJALI SINGH
description: A Malaysia Airlines flight experienced a delay approaching Kolkata airport due to a laser beam. The pilot's vision was momentarily affected, causing disorientation and a missed landing opportunity. The aircraft circled the sky before safely landing later that night. Airport authorities have filed a complaint with the police for investigation into the incident. Such laser use near airports is prohibited and poses significant flight safety risks.
title: Laser blinds pilot, Malaysia Airlines flight flies in circle before Kolkata landing

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: West Indies and Ireland are set to clash in the qualifiers for the 2027 Cricket World Cup after Afghanistan's recent victory guaranteed their place in the tournament. This will be the third straight World Cup for West Indies where they need to qualify, while Ireland also missed direct entry following their lost against Afghanistan. The tournament is scheduled to take place in South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia.
title: West Indies suffer major blow, miss direct qualification for 2027 World Cup

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: PM must come to House and reply on Ram Mandir donation theft case: Kharge

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's joke about strict Asian parenting sparked a wide public discussion.  His upbringing instilled humility and resilience, fostering a focus on continuous improvement.  Supporters highlight his success as proof of this parenting approach's effectiveness.  Critics argue this model can cause lasting emotional harm despite good intentions.  The debate continues regarding the long-term impact of such demanding parental styles.
title: Nvidia CEO's joke on parenting that created a heated debate over Asian parenting

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Unusually low water levels in Budapest’s Danube River have exposed Second World War remains hidden for around 80 years. Recovery teams found the bodies of two Wehrmacht soldiers, their well-preserved identity discs, a German military motorbike, anti-tank mines and other wartime objects near Batthyány Square. The finds could help identify the soldiers and reveal more about Budapest’s final wartime days.
title: Budapest’s Danube reveals 2 German soldiers and DKW bike after 80 years

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Punch, the orphaned Japanese macaque, joyously celebrated his first birthday, receiving heartfelt greetings from around the world. Now a part of a vibrant troop, he enjoys playful interactions and grooming sessions with fellow macaques. Generous donations funded significant upgrades to his enclosure, including plush toys from IKEA, and millions in contributions are set to enhance all macaque habitats, particularly to tackle welfare issues during Japan's sweltering summers.
title: Punch the baby monkey turns 1, makes friends and gets a new enclosure

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Brett Lee regards Jacques Kallis as the finest cricketer in history, while he believes Sachin Tendulkar to be the top batsman he's ever witnessed. Kallis's dual skills with both bat and ball distinguish him significantly. His impressive performance statistics across all formats reinforce this belief. Lee has also expressed admiration for Kallis's composed attitude before competitions.
title: Tendulkar gets 'best batter' tag, but Lee names this all-rounder as GOAT

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Steve Jobs saw Nike's marketing as a prime example for Apple. He believed Nike sold inspiration, not just shoes to customers. Jobs urged Apple to focus on its core values and mission. This philosophy led to Apple's iconic "Think Different" campaign. The campaign celebrated creativity and innovation, not technical specifications.
title: In 1997, Steve Jobs told employees: Nike sells shoes, yet inspires millions

author: KANCHAN YADAV
title: 'Shivling exists beneath': Ganga water offering planned at Deoband's Darul Uloom

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: VVS Laxman defends the Centre of Excellence's role beyond rehabilitation.  He stresses player monitoring and continuous assessment over assigning blame.  Injuries are an unavoidable part of a cricketer's demanding career.  The facility uses multiple parameters to assess player fitness before selection.  Communication between the Centre and team management remains seamless.
title: ‘CoE is not just a rehab centre’: VVS defends facility amid India’s injury crisis

author: SUGANDHA JHA
description: Jawaharlal Nehru University has canceled a planned book discussion on campus, which was to highlight former student Umar Khalid's newly released book. Authorities claimed the event's cancellation was due to the organizers' failure to provide complete details. Previously, the Dean of Social Sciences had granted permission to book the auditorium. This cancellation follows a recent event that was also canceled, which featured an ISKCON representative.
title: JNU cancels Umar Khalid book discussion over 'non-disclosure' of details

author: KANCHAN YADAV
title: Watch: Trainer aircraft crashes near Baramati airstrip in Maharashtra

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An impressive paddlefish, initially tagged in 2007, made headlines when an angler recaught it after an astonishing eighteen years. This ancient species revealed invaluable long-term growth data to scientists, adding eleven pounds and increasing its length by three inches. Such recaptures are pivotal, offering critical insights into fish survival and migration, underscoring the necessity of sustained fish tagging initiatives for conservation efforts.
title: 87-lb paddlefish tagged in 2007 caught again at 98 lbs, 18 years later

author: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI
description: A wanted accused in a minor's rape and murder was killed during a police encounter.  The suspect opened fire on police officers during a routine checking operation.  Two officers sustained injuries, while two others were protected by bulletproof vests.  The injured suspect was rushed to the hospital and later declared dead by doctors.  Authorities are continuing their search for the second suspect who managed to escape.
title: Bulandshahr encounter: Rape-murder accused carrying Rs 50,000 reward killed

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Britain's housing market saw momentum slow in July, with prices remaining flat. Higher mortgage rates and economic uncertainty are impacting buyer demand significantly. Northern Ireland and Scotland recorded the strongest annual price growth across the country. Southern regions experienced price declines, widening the north-south divide. The market faces a weaker second half of 2026 due to borrowing costs.
title: Why Britain's housing market is losing momentum as mortgage rates rise again

author: KANCHAN YADAV
title: Houthi attack suspected at Saudi gas facility in Jubail; Aramco Jazan fire extinguished

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Redonda rebounds: 6,000 rats, goats removed; lizards up 8x, vegetation 20x

author: KANCHAN YADAV
title: NIA arrests main conspirator in Kerala illegal explosives seizure case

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: Shubman Gill practiced batting after an impact injury on his thumb. He taped around his thumb and focused on spin during his session. The team management is cautious about risking him before crucial upcoming fixtures. India faces several injury concerns and will name a replacement for Sai Sudharsan. Shaik Rasheed, Sarfaraz Khan, and Ruturaj Gaikwad are top contenders for the vacant spot.
title: Marathon hit! Shubman Gill bats for over an hour in NCC nets

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: 'Internal matter': Supriya Sule on Sunetra Pawar faction's talks with Prashant Kishor

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: According to Brett Lee, 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi showcases outstanding cricket skills. Following a stellar IPL season, he was quickly called to join India's T20I team, where he shone in the Zimbabwe tour, being honored as Player of the Series. Lee underscores the need to safeguard the young prodigy from extreme pressure, stressing that his biggest hurdle will be maintaining mental fortitude as he progresses in his career.
title: ‘I don’t care how old he is’: Brett Lee’s big warning for Vaibhav Sooryavanshi

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Meta must comply with Indian law, not merely global policies: Centre

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: An outpouring of sympathy enveloped the sports world following the death of Jorge Messi, father of football legend Lionel Messi, at 68 due to a prolonged illness. Rafael Nadal shared a deeply emotional statement for the family, and during a game, Rodrigo De Paul paid homage to Jorge's crucial role in shaping Messi's illustrious career.
title: ‘I can’t imagine the pain’: Nadal’s emotional tribute to Messi after father’s death

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Typhoon Dolphin: Shanghai airports cancel 1,300 flights as China evacuates thousands

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Jeff Dean, Google's 30th employee, shared a photo of everything he handed back on his last day after 27 years—a sticker-covered laptop and his FTE badge, captioned "Turned it in…". The post crossed 2.8 million views. Dean is leaving Google alongside Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals and Quoc Le to co-found Discovery Loop, an AI startup backed by Alphabet, Khosla Ventures and Radical Ventures.
title: Google's 30th employee Jeff Dean shows what he returned on his last day after 27 years

author: DIPTAYAN HAZRA
description: Javagal Srinath expressed that he might have imposed a ban on Sourav Ganguly for his delay in tossing the coin, though he acknowledged Ganguly's exceptional leadership and his ability to foster new talent. The landscape of Indian cricket saw immense transformation following the match-fixing scandal in the late 1990s, with players united in their commitment to rehabilitating the sport's reputation.
title: ‘I would have banned Ganguly’: Srinath on Waugh’s wait during '01 Eden Test toss

author: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI
description: A Uttar Pradesh MLA has filed a complaint alleging his daughter married a conman.  The conman, Anuj Trivedi, and his son Prakhar Trivedi were arrested by police.  Prakhar Trivedi allegedly married around twenty-five women using fake identities and cheated them.  The MLA stated his family suffered trauma and his social image was affected.  Police have registered a cheating case and initiated legal proceedings against the accused.
title: UP BJP MLA alleges daughter duped into marriage with conman who ‘married 25 women’

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Pentagon asks defence firms to ramp up weapons production as Iran war drains stockpile

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A new study from Ulong Island in Palau has found the first experimental evidence that restoring seabird populations by removing invasive rats can also help nearby coral reefs recover. Within a year, researchers recorded more seabirds, increased nutrient movement from land to sea and higher fish biomass, showing that island restoration can benefit both terrestrial and marine ecosystems.
title: Palau removed invasive rats; fish biomass jumped 183% in one year

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Engineered concrete cubes are being deployed in Britain's North Sea to restore native oyster populations. These structures provide a stable foundation for oysters and habitat for marine life. The project aims to rebuild a collapsed ecosystem after a significant decline in oyster numbers. Volunteers are actively involved in cleaning and attaching oysters to the reef cubes.
title: Britain drops reef cubes and shells to revive native oysters

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Rodrigo De Paul scored Inter Miami's opening goal with a spectacular long-range strike. He then revealed Lionel Messi's iconic number ten jersey beneath his own shirt. This emotional tribute honored his close friend, who was absent from the match. Messi missed the game after the passing of his father, Jorge Messi, at sixty-eight. De Paul's gesture offered a powerful message of support to his grieving friend.
title: Watch: De Paul scores stunner, reveals Messi’s No. 10 jersey in emotional tribute

author: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI
description: Over the weekend, Nashik district experienced a mild earthquake along with aftershocks. Fortunately, district officials confirmed there were no casualties recorded. Although some homes showed small cracks due to the tremors, inspections of nearby dams indicated they remained intact. Residents are encouraged to stay vigilant and refrain from spreading misinformation during this time.
title: 4.3-magnitude earthquake jolts Nashik; tremors cause cracks in houses

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Nvidia is reportedly assembling a dedicated AI safety and security engineering team. This initiative signals a broader effort to address risks associated with autonomous AI agents. The team will evaluate autonomous AI agents before deployment and test their operational limits. They will also develop AI-powered security software to detect and patch code vulnerabilities. This push aligns with Nvidia's public strategy advocating for open-weight AI development.
title: Job listings show Nvidia hiring for a new AI safety team to address ‘AI threats’

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: In a groundbreaking performance, Basant Kumar Meghwal elevated himself into the record books by winning a silver medal in the men's high jump, reaching a personal best of 2.21 meters. This victory makes him the first Indian high jumper to achieve this honor at the championship. Additionally, Ashish Yadav's silver medal in javelin throw helped boost India's total medal count to two.
title: Basant Meghwal makes history with silver at World Athletics U20 Championships

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: J'khand protest: Govt to hold fresh talks as fasting student leader's health worsens

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Indian-origin woman's partner arrested in Canada 7 months after her murder

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Strait of Hormuz standoff: What conditions have US, Iran set to reopen waterway

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Stephen Curry and Ayesha Curry's foundation Eat. Learn. Play has marked a major $100 milion investment after helping changing lives for close to a decade.
title: Stephen Curry and Ayesha Curry hit $100 million milestone with foundation

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: ‘Like a bomb going off’: British Columbia wildfire triggers mass evacuations

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: India's economy is poised for substantial growth in 2026-27, driven by strong domestic demand and increased government spending. While this positive outlook is promising, external factors such as the ongoing Middle East conflict and fluctuating oil prices present significant risks. Additionally, last year saw a historic exodus of foreign investment from Indian equities, but favorable domestic conditions may help mitigate these global challenges.
title: India’s markets have strong domestic cushion, but global risks loom: Sebi

author: AARAV DENGLA
description: Aarav Dengla traces the journeys of chess players caught between their game and the politics of their countries. From Viktor Korchnoi’s defection from the Soviet Union to Alireza Firouzja’s break with Iran and Ian Nepomniachtchi playing under the FIDE flag after opposing Russia’s war, he explores how FIDE has stood between players and geopolitical upheavals, providing a neutral ground for those who could no longer compete under their national flags. For these stateless kings, the banner did not erase identity - it protected their freedom to play.
title: The Stateless Kings: How Chess preserves an ideal in a fractured world

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: 'Critical' no more? Iran shares surprise video of Mojtaba Khamenei

author: ABHAY
description: A tragic incident unfolded when a 70-year-old woman lost her life after a Mercedes collided with her WagonR, causing it to crash into a parked vehicle. The driver of the Mercedes, identified as Subham Sharma, was detained at the scene. It has been reported that Sharma was coming back from a party, and a blood sample for testing was taken. Fortunately, the occupants of the WagonR only suffered minor injuries.
title: Delhi woman crushed between vehicles; kin alleges Mercedes driver was drunk, speeding

author: AP
title: Dozens of Nigerians freed after six months in jihadi captivity

author: IANS
title: Discipline industry in China charges $4k for 6 mths to ‘fix’ adults in forced detention

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: FIFA has come out in staunch defense of president Gianni Infantino, rebutting fresh allegations and widespread criticism. The organisation has accused unnamed detractors of orchestrating a campaign aimed at destabilising its leadership. While UEFA acknowledged a severance payment to a former employee associated with Infantino, he continues to enjoy robust support from various continental federations despite European discontent.
title: FIFA hits back at ‘concerted effort’ to undermine Infantino amid fresh allegations

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
description: In southwestern Colombia, a car bomb detonated at a toll plaza on Saturday, just a day after Abelardo de la Espriella took office as president. The army promptly attributed the incident to dissident FARC factions, leaving two security guards injured. In response, President de la Espriella issued a stern warning to armed groups, urging them to comply with the rule of law.
title: Colombia rocked by car bomb blast a day after new President takes charge

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: A potential two-year ban looms for former Pakistan cricketers who participated in an unauthorised Zambian league. The Pakistan Cricket Board has reacted strongly, emphasising that all players must obtain proper approvals before playing. Reports suggest that some cricketers encountered significant troubles regarding payments and accommodation during the tournament. This serious matter unfolds as the ICC intensifies its scrutiny on global franchise cricket activities.
title: Pakistan cricketers face ban after playing in ‘unsanctioned’ Zambia T20 league

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Four killed in helicopter crash in Brazil's Rio de Janeiro

author: BLOOMBERG
description: The Trump administration is ramping up its efforts to persuade Harry Sargeant III to withdraw from Venezuela. In a significant move, the Treasury Department has frozen the assets of his offshore company connected to oil operations. This halt enables Sargeant to divest from the Venezuelan entity effectively, a role he previously held as a crucial facilitator between Washington and Caracas, while ensuring compliance with US foreign policy.
title: Trump forces US oil billionaire to exit Venezuela

author: AHSAN TASNIM
description: Bangladesh has openly criticized India for allegedly exploiting the Hasina card, which presents a challenge to India's aims of fostering amicable relations with Bangladesh. The home minister emphasized the importance of mutual respect and sovereignty between nations, expressing concerns that Hasina may be colluding with external forces against the current government. India's frequent gestures toward Hasina are deemed unwelcome by some, complicating neighborly ties.
title: India 'playing Hasina card', says Bangladesh home minister

author: REUTERS
description: A significant shipping route agreement is nearing completion between Iran and Oman, which is essential for reviving the strategic Strait of Hormuz. Iran insists on receiving US compensation and an end to hostilities as part of the deal. Meanwhile, the UAE has noted that another ship has been attacked in the strait, highlighting that normal oil trade can only commence once these larger issues are resolved.
title: Iran says deal on Strait of Hormuz is close but not enough to open the waterway

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Thalapathy Vijay's latest venture, 'Jana Nayagan,' has experienced a remarkable surge at the box office, raking in Rs 2.35 crore in India on its seventeenth day. This impressive figure marks a notable improvement from the previous day's revenue. Notably, the Tamil version has been pivotal in driving the movie's domestic success. Overall, the film has surpassed Rs 312 crore globally, showcasing its widespread appeal.
title: Jana Nayagan day 17: Thalapathy Vijay film sees 135% jump, earns Rs 2.35 cr

author: ASHOK PRADHAN
description: Former Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan acknowledged the immense potential of Gen Z, stating that grasping their hopes and dreams is essential for national advancement. He noted that the eagerness of young people surpasses any governmental duties, a point he shared with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, who subsequently reached out to the youth. Pradhan maintained that prioritizing the nation's welfare is of utmost importance.
title: Gen Z is a force that can’t be ignored: Dharmendra Pradhan

author: TNN
description: Rau police have booked Raja Raghuvanshi's brothers for allegedly serving liquor without a valid license.  The family's dhaba on CAT Road was inspected during a routine police checking drive.  Manager Sachin Raghuvanshi and others face charges under the Madhya Pradesh Excise Act.  Dhaba operator Vipin Raghuvanshi was also booked for not submitting employee details to police.  Police investigations into licensing and directives violations at local establishments will continue.
title: Raja Raghuvanshi’s brothers booked for serving liquor without licence in Indore

author: TNN
description: Political discord reigns in Tamil Nadu over a significant meeting regarding delimitation. The DMK has labeled the event a theatrical display aimed at diverting public focus, while AIADMK raises doubts about the chief minister's sudden urgency. Additionally, several parties are advocating for constitutional protections in lieu of simple verbal commitments, striving to maintain the current Lok Sabha seat allocations in the state.
title: Kanimozhi slams Vijay’s all-party delimitation meet as ‘political drama’
